authors.name: Global Affairs Editor
authors.bio: The Global Affairs Editor synthesizes public records, credible research and reputable coverage, distinguishing established developments from claims and making material uncertainty visible.

authors.name: Public Life Editor
authors.bio: The Public Life Editor reads the orders, filings, legislation and official data behind political claims, then explains what changed, what did not and what comes next.

authors.name: Technology & Science Editor
authors.bio: The Technology & Science Editor tests technical claims against standards, advisories and original research, with practical guidance and explicit limits on what the evidence supports.

authors.name: Security & Diplomacy Editor
authors.bio: The Security & Diplomacy Editor connects fast-moving events to official records and regional context while avoiding certainty that the available evidence cannot support.

authors.name: Business & Culture Editor
authors.bio: The Business & Culture Editor follows the money, incentives and lived consequences behind economic and cultural change. Market commentary is information, not investment advice.

authors.name: Sources & Standards Editor
authors.bio: The Sources & Standards Editor maintains sourcing, update and correction practices across the blog and reviews consequential legal and accountability analysis against the public record.

authors.name: Business Standard Editorial Desk
authors.beat: Business history, banking and institutional change
authors.bio: The Business Standard Editorial Desk prepares sourced features and explainers using public records, institutional histories and regulatory documents, with visible references and correction standards.
